summary.en: Two Philippine Coast Guard bomb experts were wounded when explosives detonated inside their Zamboanga City barracks, and two other Coast Guard members were injured in a separate blast at the same location. The AFP monitored a Chinese aircraft carrier and militia vessels transiting near Mindanao and Zamboanga coasts, stating the passage was not a cause for alarm. The Philippines, United States and Japan completed their 22nd multilateral maritime cooperative activity in the West Philippine Sea, continuing joint drills in the area. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: To bombeksperter fra Filippinenes kystvakt ble såret da eksplosiver detonerte inne i deres barakk i Zamboanga City, og to andre medlemmer av kystvakten ble skadet i en separat eksplosjon på samme sted. AFP overvåket et kinesisk hangarskip og militærfartøyer som seilte forbi kysten av Mindanao og Zamboanga, og uttalte at passasjen ikke var grunn til alarm. Filippinene, USA og Japan fullførte sin 22. multilaterale maritime samarbeidsaktivitet i Vestfilippinene, og fortsatte fellesøvelser i området. 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
